title: Kendall in 2026: A Buyer's Guide to Miami's Space-and-Value Suburb
deck: Kendall gives Miami buyers more space for the money, but the name covers a lot of ground. Here is how to choose the right corner of it.

title: FIRPTA Explained: What Foreign Sellers Keep at Closing
deck: If you live outside the U.S. and sell a Miami home, the IRS can hold back part of the price at closing. Here is how FIRPTA works and how to plan for it.

title: Why the Holidays Are a Smart Time to Buy in Miami
deck: While most buyers pause for December, the ones who keep looking often find less competition, sellers ready to deal and a head start on the new year.
